notes:
02: metadata API fetches title/description/domain only; favicon is a domain-letter placeholder and no preview image is ever collected. 06: save() always creates a new item with a fresh id when no id is present; no URL de-duplication or convergence to editing an existing bookmark. 10: tags entered as a plain comma text field, no autocomplete/datalist of existing tags. 11: tags render as non-clickable spans; sidebar filters only All/Favorites/hardcoded collections, no tag filter. 12: full-text search covers title/description/tags and only the domain, not the full url path; note is same field as description. 14: no #tag search syntax. 15: no AND/OR/NOT or parentheses parsing. 16: no quoted-phrase exact match. 17-19: no unread/read-later flag, no unread view, no mark-as-read. 20-21: no multi-select or bulk actions, filter-scoped or otherwise. 23: 'Note' field stores plain text bound to description and is rendered as plain

, no markdown parsing/rendering. 24-25: no HTML/PDF snapshot or Internet Archive integration. 26-28: no archive flag, no archive/delete distinction, no archived list. 29: 'Collections' are three hardcoded categories with single assignment, not saved search+included/excluded-tag bundles. 30-31: no Netscape HTML import or export. 32: no settings panel; only an ephemeral two-state sort toggle, no persisted default sort, displayed items, or font size.
